question: Which of the following was the port-city of the Pandyan Kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Korkai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Korkai** was the principal port-city of the ancient Pandyan Kingdom.
 
• The Pandyan Kingdom was one of the longest-ruling dynasties in the history of South India, known for its rich culture and architecture.
